lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag maalee gauRaa mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Raag Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik jatan kar rahe har a(n)t naahee paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Countless have tried, but none have found the Lord's limit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har agam agam agaadh bodh aades har prabh raaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Lord is inaccessible, unapproachable and unfathomable; I humbly bow to the Lord God, my King. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਝਗਰਤੇ ਝਗਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu nit jhagarate jhagaraaiaa ||
lines.translation: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment bring continual conflict and strife.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਦੀਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ham raakh raakh deen tere har saran har prabh aaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Save me, save me, I am your humble creature, O Lord; I have come to Your Sanctuary, O my Lord God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਲਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saranaagatee prabh paalate har bhagat vachhal naaiaa ||
lines.translation: You protect and preserve those who take to Your Sanctuary, God; You are called the Lover of Your devotees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਨਾਖਿ ਪਕਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਓ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: prahilaad jan haranaakh pakariaa har raakh leeo taraaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: Prahlaad, Your humble servant, was caught by Harnaakhash; but You saved Him and carried him across, Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵਣ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har chet re man mahal paavan sabh dookh bha(n)jan raaiaa ||
lines.translation: Remember the Lord, O mind, and rise up to the Mansion of His Presence; the Sovereign Lord is the Destroyer of pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bhau janam maran nivaar thaakur har guramatee prabh paaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: Our Lord and Master takes away the fear of birth and death; following the Guru's Teachings, the Lord God is found. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਉ ਭਗਤ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har patit paavan naam suaamee bhau bhagat bha(n)jan gaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord, our Lord and Master, is the Purifier of sinners; I sing of the Lord, the Destroyer of the fears of His devotees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har haar har ur dhaario jan naanak naam samaaiaa ||4||1||
lines.translation: One who wears the necklace of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in his heart, O servant Nanak, merges in the Naam. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: maalee gauRaa mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap man raam naam sukhadaataa ||
lines.translation: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, the Giver of peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gat mil har saad aaiaa guramukh braham pachhaataa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: One who joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and enjoys the sublime taste of the Lord, as Gurmukh, comes to realize God. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaagee gur darasan paaiaa gur miliai har prabh jaataa ||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, one obtains the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan; meeting with the Guru, the Lord God is known.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਨੀਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: duramat mail gaee sabh neekar har a(n)mrit har sar naataa ||1||
lines.translation: The filth of evil-mindedness is totally washed away, bathing in the Lord's ambrosial pool of nectar. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਪੂਛਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan dhan saadh jinhee har prabh paaiaa tinh poochhau har kee baataa ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed are the Holy, who have found their Lord God; I ask them to tell me the stories of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਉ ਜੁਦਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: paai lagau nit karau judareeaa har melahu karam bidhaataa ||2||
lines.translation: I fall at their feet, and always pray to them, to mercifully unite me with my Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਿਲਾਟ ਲਿਖੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: lilaat likhe paaiaa gur saadhoo gur bachanee man tan raataa ||
lines.translation: Through the destiny written on my forehead, I have found the Holy Guru; my mind and body are imbued with the Guru's Word.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har prabh aai mile sukh paaiaa sabh kilavikh paap gavaataa ||3||
lines.translation: The Lord God has come to meet me; I have found peace, and I am rid of all the sins. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam rasaain jinh guramat paaiaa tinh kee ootam baataa ||
lines.translation: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings find the Lord, the source of nectar; their words are sublime and exalted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੰਕ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚਰਨਿ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tin kee pa(n)k paaeeai vadabhaagee jan naanak charan paraataa ||4||2||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, one is blessed with the dust of their feet; servant Nanak falls at their feet. ||4||2||
